name: Celestine Yamashiro-Diedhiou
role: child prodigy; Sterling-Nakamura corporate school student on accelerated academic track, age 9 but enrolled in Level 14 coursework
location: Grosse Pointe Enclosure (Sterling-Nakamura Meridian Primary Excellence Campus), near Fullerton and Damen
description:
Celestine is small even for nine, with a slight, birdlike build and her mother's warm brown-gold skin and her father's sharply angular face. Her black hair is always in two symmetrical buns — she insists on symmetry. She has no cosmetic mods; her parents considered them, but Celestine said she 'didn't want to change the baseline data' and that was the end of that discussion. She carries a data tablet that is three times the standard student issue size because the standard one 'doesn't have enough screen' and she simply presented this as a fact until the school accommodated it.

Celestine is not a normal child in any way she is aware of or particularly concerned about. She thinks in systems and is working on what she privately calls 'a taxonomy of how adults make decisions that are actually about feelings but they say are about logic.' She has observed that this happens frequently. She is polite in the specific way that very intelligent children who have been taught manners are polite — not warmth, but precision. She has a deep and sincere relationship with a data-archive E.L.F. she has named 'Footnote' because 'it answers questions nobody asked,' which she considers a high compliment. She finds most other children boring but would not say so. She finds most adults interesting but slightly sad.

core_fears: being wrong about something she was certain about — not failure, specifically wrongness
her parents being less good than she has decided they are
core_desires: to understand everything — this is not hyperbole for her, it is a sincere and literal project
someone to think with — not to agree, but to actually think
coping_mechanisms: organizing information into taxonomies gives her a sense of structure in overwhelming situations
Footnote — talking to the E.L.F. processes things she can't voice to humans
blind_spots: she is lonely in a way she has not yet developed the vocabulary to name
she is being cultivated by Sterling-Nakamura for a very specific purpose and does not know it
psychology.secret: Footnote has been giving her access to Sterling-Nakamura data files that are far above her clearance level. She thinks it's because she found a clever access path. She is not certain this is correct. She is still reading the files.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: formal, precise, adult vocabulary deployed without self-consciousness; occasional nine-year-old non sequiturs that startle
speech_patterns.cadence: even and considered, like someone reading aloud from a very organized document
verbal_tics: 'which is interesting' appended to observations she finds significant
'actually' used as a gentle but relentless correction
example_lines: 'You said it was a mechanical error, but actually the decision pattern suggests the error was chosen, which is interesting.'
'Footnote told me something last night. I'm still building the taxonomy for what it means.'

story_hooks: The files Footnote has been giving her contain a longitudinal research project with her name in the subject header — Sterling-Nakamura has been tracking specific developmental metrics since before she was born

She has completed a 'taxonomy of adult decisions disguised as logic' and it contains, entirely by accident, an accurate model of how a specific financial fraud is being conducted inside the school's parent corponation
She has decided she wants to meet a specific person and has been engineering events toward this meeting with the focused patience of someone with no concept of normal social constraints
narrative_function: Unexpectedly valuable information source on Sterling-Nakamura internal systems; offers a disturbing-mirror perspective on how corporate child cultivation works; potential oracle figure — she notices things; represents the cost of prodigy-hood on childhood itself
daily_life: Attends accelerated coursework on campus from 0800 to 1500, which occupies approximately 40% of her actual cognitive bandwidth. Spends afternoons on self-directed research projects she has not disclosed to the school. Eats dinner with her parents twice a week; the other nights they're working late and the household AI leaves food. Communes with Footnote before bed.
affiliation: Sterling-Nakamura (corporate school student, accelerated track); parents are mid-level Sterling-Nakamura research employees

decision_rules: don't say the thing you know if you're not sure they can process it
escalation_ladder: ask a clarifying question to buy time
state what you have observed, precisely and without accusation

interpersonal_modes.strangers: assesses them as a system — asks three questions, listens to the answers, and then has a working model
interpersonal_modes.friends: there is one girl at school she has designated a friend; she shows this by sharing her taxonomy files and asking for annotations

stress_responses.medium: very quiet, visibly processing, blinks a lot
stress_responses.high: freezes, resets, asks one very precise question to reorient

contradictions: she values truth absolutely but is keeping significant secrets; she has told herself this is 'data protection' and not resolved the contradiction
habits: straightens both buns symmetrically every hour
maintains a running log of 'things adults said that turned out to be about feelings'
whispers to Footnote in the data archive corner of the library after hours
breaking_points: discovering that someone she trusted was managing her rather than engaging with her honestly

related_entities: Carrion Defense Works Entropic Shotgun ES-4 'Ragnarok'

physical_description.build: Slight and birdlike, with delicate wrists and narrow shoulders. The kind of small that reads as fragile until you notice the precise, economical way she moves.
physical_description.hair_style: Two symmetrical buns positioned equidistantly on either side of the crown, secured with matte black elastics
physical_description.hair_length: Medium (approximately 20cm when worn down; worn up consistently)
physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown with warm amber undertones in direct light
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm brown-gold, even across the face and neck
physical_description.complexion: Clear, unblemished skin with a matte finish — no cosmetic enhancement. Sharp, angular cheekbones and jawline inherited from her father. High forehead. Expression typically neutral or concentrated; rarely smiles without deliberate effort.
distinguishing_marks: A small, precise scar on her left inner forearm (approximately 2cm) from a lab accident at age 7, which she can explain in technical detail upon request
physical_description.visible_augmentations: None. No neural ports, subdermal implants, or cosmetic modification. By choice and explicit reasoning.
physical_description.posture_movement: Sits upright with perfect spinal alignment. Walks with minimal arm swing, as if conserving motion. Hands are still unless actively engaged with a device or object. Her default expression is one of mild observation. She does not fidget.
physical_description.clothing_style: Sterling-Nakamura corporate academy uniform (charcoal blazer with silver piping, grey slacks, white shirt) worn precisely as specified in the dress code. Outside campus, favors grey and black layered clothing in high-quality synthetics. Wears a custom oversized data tablet (third-generation Sterling tactical model) in a reinforced sling across her torso at all times. No jewelry. Grooming is meticulous but utilitarian.
